best_for: Online U.S. stock trading with fund-specific transaction charges.

checked_profile.summary: Online U.S. stock trading with fund-specific transaction charges.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Online stock and ETF trades
facts.text: $0 commissions on online U.S. equity and ETF trades. Representative-assisted and other transaction charges can apply.

facts.label: Opening minimum
facts.text: The pricing page lists no minimum to open an account; individual investments can have their own minimums.

facts.label: Mutual funds
facts.text: Fidelity funds have $0 transaction fees. Non-Fidelity transaction-fee funds generally cost $49.95 per purchase, with certain funds up to $100. Eligible no-transaction-fee funds are $0 to buy but may carry a $49.95 short-term redemption fee when held under 60 days.

facts.label: Options
facts.text: $0 base commission does not mean free options trading: contract fees apply. Review the full commission schedule for the order you intend to place.

questions: Which pricing plan and fee schedule apply to my account and intended trades?
